artifact_identity: extension-source-r1.json pins the immutable release URL, directory SHA-256 and metadata; compute and commit the extracted native payload manifest SHA-256 before execution
population: All 5658 canonical policy documents at the existing pinned subject revision; no new subject, exclusion, namespace or resource-family trimming
rules: Check df -h before every heavy step; require at least 20 GiB free, load<=6, nice10 and the lane's serial lock. Keep dependencies, native artifacts, scratch and GOCACHE private to this lane.

Extract only the self-contained osx-arm64 payload from bounded version-pinned ZIP ranges. Validate directory identity, local headers, CRCs, sizes and paths; refuse symlinks and excessive counts/expansion. Record native hashes before execution.

Do not activate VS Code, authenticate to Azure, pass ambient credentials, call a paid service or run Docker. Test the native server with a clean private environment and process-local external-network denial; no global security or agent configuration changes.

First inspect startup, LSP capabilities and the documented loopback evaluation route on authored inputs. A compiled evaluator or generic LSP client method name does not prove a binding or source-position API.
Require authored valid/invalid-parameter, unused-declaration, namespace, source-position and identity controls before using any evaluated field as oracle truth.

Enumerate the whole native definition/parameter-use population before comparison. The independent JSON walk may classify positions only with separately disclosed authority, never choose the reference denominator or supply missing native fields.

Runtime evaluation traces attest visited fields only. Never label recall A over trace-selected or independent-walk-selected pairs. Classify short-circuited, unsupported or unenumerated cases explicitly; fail the native family rather than silently remove them.

If authored controls establish a complete native route, freeze the canonical subject using the exact normative tracked-set recipe before/after and measure the unchanged population. Otherwise record the concrete native failure or still-unbuilt route; do not call it an oracle-availability ceiling.
No L3 measurement before the controller's D19 authorization. Publish counts/hashes/relative summaries, never subject content or wholesale file lists.
Delete measured subjects, native downloads and extracted payload after packaging receipts; retain no source build or Docker artifact. A preparation receipt is not an execution or calibration receipt.
